question: Does AuroraPIC's mover-stage energetic-promotion deficit persist when its MCC and field-push ledger use the same leapfrog half-step velocity staggering as native eduPIC?

basis.observed_before_declaration: The time-centered AuroraPIC branches had native-ensemble field-push promotion-rate ratios 0.80585 and 0.79340. No matched-half-step branch output existed when this rule was declared.
basis.state_transition: Each locked step-24000 checkpoint is exported to a portable state containing live time-centered positions and velocities. AuroraPIC rebuilds the adjacent half-step velocity from the self-consistent field, runs one complete RF cycle with leapfrog-half-step MCC sampling, and only then starts the four-cycle diagnostic window.
basis.phase_continuity: The source checkpoint is at exactly six RF cycles and the portable-state run starts at the same configured RF phase, so resetting simulation time preserves the drive phase modulo one RF cycle.
basis.export_limit: The portable state intentionally does not preserve the checkpoint RNG, fields, half-step velocities, counters, or diagnostics; these are rebuilt or restarted under the declared branch contract.

prospective_decision_rule.deficit_persists_if: both matched-half-step AuroraPIC/native promotion-rate ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.staggering_explains_deficit_if: both matched-half-step AuroraPIC/native promotion-rate ratios lie in [0.95, 1.05]
prospective_decision_rule.partial_staggering_effect_if: all gates pass but neither persistence nor parity criterion is met
prospective_decision_rule.candidate_repeatability_gate: relative range across the two matched-half-step AuroraPIC microstates no greater than 0.08 for field-push promotion and demotion rates

claim_boundary: This prospective campaign tests one velocity-staggering mechanism in one argon CCP using two constrained AuroraPIC microstates and the already-locked three-seed native ensemble. The portable-state transition resets the random stream and permits one RF cycle of relaxation. It is not experimental validation, a published-observable acceptance result, an unrestricted uncertainty analysis, or proof of general PIC correctness.
